**Glint 1.2.3 — Dynamic Island for iOS 12.5.8 (iPhone 5s)**

* Real-time countdown timer MM:SS beside the status clock with alert chime
* Safari audio integration with live 5-band equalizer & beat-reactive pulsing
* Customizable edge lighting: solid color, rainbow cycle, or 1s breathing blink
* Charging indicator with green pulse and fast battery percentage readout
* 100% Main Thread UI & lazy window init (Zero Safe Mode guarantee)
* Settings app integration (Settings > Glint) with instant apply without respring
* Strict Pure GNU Tar format (resolves corrupted filesystem tarfile error)

**Compatibility:** iPhone 5s (Apple A7 arm64), iOS 12.0 – 12.5.8.
**Architecture:** Rootful Sileo / Zebra / Cydia APT.
